name: Semiconductors
definition: Semiconductors are engineered materials and devices that control electrical current; the industry spans design, fabrication, equipment, packaging, and distribution.
happening: Leading-edge logic demand is being pulled forward by AI accelerators, while memory is recovering from a deep inventory correction. The supply chain is becoming more regional, expensive, and policy-dependent.
why: Chips are the physical substrate for computing, communications, and industrial automation. A bottleneck in one layer can set the capacity and pricing power of the entire digital economy.
risk: The risk map includes Taiwan concentration, export controls, cyclical overbuild, and a widening gap between leading-edge demand and mature-node utilization.

timeline.event: AI accelerators create a new scarcity
Regional capacity race moves into construction
